prompt: Vertical 9:16 photograph looking straight down from the ceiling of a British church hall at night, cheap colour film, heavy grain, cold fluorescent teal light. A ring of exactly twelve mismatched stacking chairs on a worn wooden floor. Seven small children in paper party hats sit on seven chairs, seen only as the tops of their heads. Four chairs are empty but claimed: a coat draped over one, a handbag on another, and folded paper cards reading RESERVED on the last two. In the very centre of the ring one small child in a party hat stands alone, seen from above, arms by their sides. Long shadows, black edges, quiet and absurd. Thanks.
